newsitem.title: USA: Myriad Genetics files for public offering.
newsitem.headline: Myriad Genetics files for public offering.

text.p: Myriad Genetics Inc said Friday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission relating to a public offering of 1,700,000 shares of its common stock
Of the 1,700,000 shares, 1,500,000 shares are to be sold by Myriad and 200,000 shares are to be sold by certain stockholders.
Cowen & Company and UBS Securities LLC will serve as underwriters for the offering, Myriad said.
Myriad said it will also grant the underwriters an option to purchase an additional 255,000 shares of common stock solely to cover over-allotments, if any.

Myriad Genetics is a gene discovery and genetic testing company focused on the discovery and commercialization of genes involved in major common diseases, including cancer, cardiovascular disease and central nervous system diseases.
